decoder.full_pixel_read_method: Every reported frame is sought, load() is called, converted to RGB in memory, and all pixel bytes are materialized using tobytes(). RGB hashes and color counts are calculated from fully decoded pixels.

expectation_sources.fact: argv[1] is passed as output directory to capture_ui_regressions::run
editor_30hz.gif and editor_jitter.gif are square GIF fixtures with twenty frames and one second of playback
editor_hidden.gif is portrait; one admitted frame and nineteen repeats finish twenty frames and one second
editor_destroyed.gif is landscape; starts at clock 2000 ms, has one admitted frame, and is stopped by destruction at 2125 ms
GIF dimensions are 540x960 portrait, 540x540 square, and 960x540 landscape
50 ms ticks; stop rounds elapsed partial slot up. A 125 ms manual interval produces three 50 ms frames (150 ms).
Loop GIF defaults to enabled and is passed into the capture request
Production writer emits GIF89a and loop-forever extension when loop is enabled; Pillow represents infinite looping as zero

limitations: This is a compatibility and content decode check of the four freshly generated native fixtures, not a claim about every possible GIF input, every platform, or production host behavior.

Pillow successfully loading all frames is an independent oracle from the project minimal GIF parser. It is not a formal GIF grammar or LZW EOI-conformance proof; no claim is made about what malformed files Pillow might tolerate.
Image content is checked for nontrivial decoded colors and sampled detail. Frame hashes describe this run; no golden-pixel identity or physically correct animation is asserted.
Hidden and destroyed fixtures are expected to repeat their sole admitted frame. Multiple distinct frames are recorded for the other fixtures without enforcing an exact unique-frame count.
Freshness is based on parent readiness confirmation, pinned source/tree, test provenance, and file mtimes inside the observed native test interval; mtimes alone are not cryptographic provenance.
No builds, app tests, fuzzing, network/service operations, or fixture image edits were performed by this verification task. Only this JSON evidence artifact was written.
